name: India
summary: In India, partners are accelerating forest rights recognition through community-grounded mapping, digital claims support, and women-led enterprise work.
featured_achievements: Odisha recognised habitat rights for seven Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups across 875,680 hectares.
ISB’s JharFRA app supports a statewide target of at least 10,000 community forest rights claims.
24 women-led producer groups were registered under the Green Shakti Producer Company.

stories.title: Forest rights recognition in Odisha
stories.summary: Rights were secured for 547 communities across eight districts, including protected areas.

stories.title: Digital claims and transparency
stories.summary: JharFRA replaced paper bottlenecks with trackable claims and shared accountability across communities and government.

stories.title: Forest rights committees as governance infrastructure
stories.summary: Community Forest Rights Management Committees were expanded as critical local governance structures.

quote.text: Transparency is at the heart of the app. Claims can be tracked by community members via a dashboard.
